headline: Agilent Introduces Gen5 AI Cell Identification Module for BioTek Automated Cell Imagers
summary: SANTA CLARA, Calif., September 29, 2026--Agilent Technologies Inc. (NYSE: A) today announced the launch of the Agilent BioTek Gen5 AI cell identification module, a new image analysis software add-on that incorporates AI-based cell identification and segmentation into BioTek Gen5 imaging analysis.
